veranderings.voor: was die Kasteel harde werk wat hulle nie kon weier nie
veranderings.na: het die Kasteel harde werk beteken wat hulle nie kon weier nie
veranderings.rede: A building cannot itself 'be' hard work; 'beteken' says what it meant to them and matches the block's closing sentence.

veranderings.na: Vir 'n lang tyd het die museums
veranderings.rede: A bare 'Lank' at the start of the sentence reads abruptly; 'Vir 'n lang tyd' is more natural and clearer for Grade 5.
'Soos' in the sense of English 'as' (while, gradually) is an anglicism; 'namate' is the Afrikaans conjunction for a gradual change.
